remarks: Brand new, very rare large format Italian tile kitchen & bath. Sun pours into this renovated/old world charm gen on the Avenue! H/W floors throughout... heat + hot water included. Tenant pays electricity and cooking gas. Laundry room around back of bldg. Municipal parking lot in back of building. Blocks to train, parks, and I95 for an easy commute/trip into NYC and ferry to Island Beach... just in time for summer! Sorry no pets.
